summary: All quality gates pass (typecheck, lint, 688/688 tests including 31 new). Wrote 31 new tests covering AC-1 through AC-6 for the duel HUD unification. ExpeditionHud correctly conditionalises duel instruments on the duel prop, renders VersusInstrument (player names, LIVE badge, connection/stale status), and RaceProgressInstrument (altitude bars with correct percentage, leader marker, slot colors). Boundary values tested (zero maxAlt, empty racers, long names, single racer). Non-test callers confirmed: ClimbScene.tsx and DuelRoom.tsx both import ExpeditionHud.

exitCriteria.test: 688/688 passed (77 files, up from 657/657 in 76 files)

AC-1.tests: expeditionHudDuel.test.tsx: 'shared instruments render identically in duel mode' (2 tests)
AC-1.method: Render ExpeditionHud with and without duel prop, assert height/clearance/utility/phase appear identically

AC-2.tests: expeditionHudDuel.test.tsx: 'duel instruments are conditional on duel prop' (2 tests)
AC-2.method: Render without duel prop and assert no exp-duel-strip/versus/race classes; render with duel prop and assert they appear

AC-3.tests: expeditionHudDuel.test.tsx: 'versus instrument and race progress' (11 tests)
AC-3.method: Assert player names, vs separator, LIVE badge (climb only), race bars with progressbar role, percentage calculation, leader marker, slot colors, aria-labels, (you) marker

AC-4.method: Assert exp-versus-opp-stale appears when opponentStale=true+climb phase; hidden when false; hidden outside climb; stale opacity classes on race bar

AC-5.method: Assert exp-versus-reconnecting for disconnected/suspended/connecting; hidden when connected; own reconnecting suppresses opponent stale

AC-6.method: DuelRoom.tsx countdown (lines 810-821) uses identical class strings as ClimbScene's Overlay component (line 653-661): 'absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-y-auto rounded-xl bg-void/70 backdrop-blur-xs p-4 text-center' + 'my-auto flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col items-center py-2' + '[ get ready ]' tag + font-display text-7xl numeral. Not a unit-testable component (DuelGame requires realtime/router), verified by code inspection.

learnings.insight: The duel countdown overlay in DuelRoom.tsx (lines 810-821) inlines the same class strings as ClimbScene's Overlay component (line 653-661) rather than importing Overlay. This is by design (Overlay is not exported), but a future refactor could extract Overlay to a shared module to enforce the pattern at the import level rather than by convention.
learnings.action: Note during review but do not block — both use identical class strings today.

learnings.insight: VersusInstrument correctly suppresses the opponent-stale message when the own connection is down (the !showReconnecting guard at line 118 of ExpeditionHud.tsx). This prevents misleading dual status messages.
learnings.action: Confirm this priority logic is correct during review.

learnings.insight: Quality gates: typecheck clean, lint 0 warnings, 688/688 tests passed (77 files). 31 new tests added for duel HUD instruments.
